name: Theo thGOLD
oneLiner: thGOLD is Theo's pre-launch gold token: one non-accruing token per troy ounce of physical gold that Theo may lease out, with yield only in separate sthGOLD.
collateral: Physical gold, per Theo's current documentation held in Theo's allocated vault account or leased to institutional counterparties on short or longer tenors; all thGOLD backing may be lent, whether or not it is staked. The January 2026 announcement instead described exposure to the MG999 Onchain Gold Fund of gold-denominated retailer loans run by FundBridge Capital with Libeara tokenization
pegMechanism: One thGOLD is documented as one troy ounce of gold that does not rebase or accrue; lease income goes only to the separate sthGOLD ERC-4626 vault, which has a 5-day redemption lockup. Direct mint and redemption against physical metal are not yet open, so the token is currently obtainable only on secondary venues
launchPhaseDetail: Theo announced thGOLD on January 27 2026 as a yield-bearing gold product tracking the MG999 Onchain Gold Fund (FundBridge Capital, Libeara tokenization), and that gold-leasing fund already backs thUSD's carry strategy. The token contract was deployed on Ethereum on September 15 2026 (0x610F0E33b0A6b3802ff29D3Cf6bBd9A0ACF784ed, 6 decimals, about 15,279 thGOLD supply on October 19 2026). Theo's current documentation, read October 19 2026, redefines the token: one thGOLD is one fixed troy ounce of physical gold held allocated or leased to institutional counterparties, it does not accrue, and lease income goes only to the separate sthGOLD vault. The 4-of-6 Operator Safe holds the minter role and a Timelock owns the UUPS proxies. Direct mint and redemption are documented as coming soon, with thGOLD meanwhile available on secondary venues. CoinGecko's thgold listing carries no contract or price, so Pharos has no usable public price feed and keeps the coin pre-launch.

featuredContent.title: Introducing thGOLD: Gold That Works for You

milestones.title: Theo introduces thGOLD, tokenized yield-bearing gold tracking the MG999 fund
milestones.description: Announcement describes gold-denominated loans to retailers through the MG999 Onchain Gold Fund operated by FundBridge Capital with Libeara tokenization, approximately 2% annual yield, a phased launch, and Phase 1 early access open to institutional partners and accredited investors.

milestones.title: thUSD launches with MG999 gold leasing as its primary yield source
milestones.description: The thUSD launch states that its gold carry strategy is powered by thGOLD and that gold is leased to retailers through the MG999 fund, confirming the underlying gold-lending fund is operational ahead of standalone thGOLD availability.

milestones.title: thGOLD token contract deployed on Ethereum
milestones.description: Theo's deployed-addresses documentation lists thGOLD at 0x610F0E33b0A6b3802ff29D3Cf6bBd9A0ACF784ed with the sthGOLD vault at 0x507243F439d65F64dfeE799159431E3A7e85A9C4; the token is a 6-decimal ERC-20 with one Operator-multisig minter. Direct mint and redemption against physical gold were still marked coming soon on October 19 2026.
